## Downloads

| File | For |
|------|-----|
| `IPhoneWebcam-Setup-<version>-x64.exe` | **Windows 11 on Intel/AMD PCs** (most PCs). Recommended. |
| `IPhoneWebcam-Setup-<version>-arm64.exe` | Windows 11 on ARM PCs (Snapdragon, e.g. Surface Pro X/11, Copilot+ PCs). |
| `IPhoneWebcam-<version>-<arch>.zip` | Manual install with `install.ps1` instead of the setup program. |
| `IPhoneWebcam-<version>-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone app, to install with Sideloadly or AltStore using your Apple ID. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of all files. |

Not sure which Windows build you need? Settings → System → About → *System type*: "x64-based processor" → x64, "ARM-based processor" → arm64.

The installers aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn: click **More info → Run anyway**.

Step-by-step instructions (including installing the iPhone app from Windows): see the [README](https://github.com/liamniou/iphone-webcam#readme).
